end_goal: A Linux-derived operating system whose kernel and system services are purpose-built to provide native computational primitives for persistent autonomous agents, long-horizon tasks, memory, experience-based learning, world-state observation, verified information acquisition, multi-agent coordination, secure tool use, and adaptive resource allocation.
current_kernel_base: Linux 6.18.44 LTS forward-port candidate; FAISAL source lineage retained from Linux v7.2-rc7

strategic_phases.name: AGI task, agent, and lifecycle substrate
Cognitive-aware scheduling and deterministic execution domains
Selective events, world-state observation, and observability
Memory, tensor objects, checkpoint, and recovery primitives
AGI system services and model orchestration
Verified internet research and source provenance
Multi-agent integration, deployment, rollback, and continuous improvement

dependencies.name: Userspace persistent memory service integrated with kernel capabilities and checkpoint references

completion_definition: The program remains active until the kernel primitives, trusted system services, AGI runtime, browser/tool boundaries, verified information pipeline, multi-agent integration, self-testing, deployment gates, monitoring, and rollback have executable evidence and no unresolved critical regressions.
